[color=#f4cccc]This mod alters building data within SVE to allow you to upgrade to the premium buildings instead of building an entirely new structure. 
[size=2]
[i]Upon upgrading, you will have duplicates of some items such as incubators, and hay hoppers. You can download [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20943]Let's Move It[/url]﻿, and hit delete while holding the items to remove them if they bother you.[/i][/size][/color][/font][font=Georgia]
[b]
[/b][img]https://imgur.com/MjDDzU6.png[/img]﻿

[color=#f4cccc]⚬ Download and unzip the file.  [/color]
[color=#f4cccc]⚬ Install this mod into where ever you keep your Stardew Valley Expanded folder. Allow it to overwrite. (if it is not popping up to overwrite, you may need to go further into your SVE folder)[/color]

[color=#f4cccc]Keep a copy in another folder for any time SVE updates and you need to rewrite the json.[/color][/font][font=Georgia][color=#f4cccc]

[img]https://imgur.com/FBLwsZn.png[/img]﻿

Everything to FlashShifter and the team that worked on SVE.[/color][/font][/center]
